messages:
support_anne: Customer ACME Reports: spikes of 504s and timeouts on hosted inference since ~09:20 UTC. They see requests queueing then hitting gateway 504. They escalated with billing concerns.
maya_oncall: looking. any reproducer or request ids from customer?
support_anne: they provided a trace id (trace=acme-9a3). sample curl they ran: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' -i` -> 504 after ~15s. Said errors concentrated during burst onboarding of new tenants.
raj_keda: interesting — looks like KEDA scaledobject cooldown is 120s for the model-pool, HPA has minReplicas=0. If warm-init takes ~20s per pod plus runtime model init ~30s, parallel bursts will queue.
ben_infra: checking controller logs. `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/keda-operator | tail -n 200` shows scaler error spikes during the window. also seeing scaledobject polling interval 30s.
mike_sre: paste relevant logs?
ben_infra: "2026-02-18T09:19:42Z scaler.go: warn scaler poll failed: metric api returned 503"
ben_infra: and from gateway: "gateway: request_queue_timeout for tenant acme after 14.8s, returning 504"
maya_oncall: that matches customer trace. sounds like two failures stacking: metric poll jitter + minReplicas=0 => delayed spin-up. KEDA annotation `cooldownPeriodSeconds` set to 120 here, needs tuning.
support_anne: customer asking for root cause and mitigation now. we should propose a short-term mitigation (hotfix) and long term config change.
raj_keda: short term: set scaledobject annotation `keda.sh/activate-pod-preset: "true"` (our internal prewarm knob) or bump minReplicas to 1 for this tenant-pool. Also reduce cooldown to 30s. Long term: set burst-capacity guard and a tiny warm pool per-tenant class.
mike_sre: agree. I can roll a canary: `kubectl patch hpa model-pool -n inference --patch '{"spec":{"minReplicas":1}}'` then monitor.
deploy-bot: deploy started by mike_sre at 2026-02-18T09:38:05Z. rollouts: patch hpa/model-pool -> minReplicas:1
ben_infra: applied patch, minReplicas=1. watching metrics.
maya_oncall: confirm whether KEDA scaledobject annotations differ per scaledobject. `kubectl get scaledobject -n inference -o yaml model-pool-scaledobj | yq .metadata.annotations`
raj_keda: current annotations: `keda.sh/cooldownPeriodSeconds: "120"`, `keda.sh/pollingInterval: "30"`, no prewarm annotation.
mike_sre: I'm enabling `keda.sh/cooldownPeriodSeconds: "30"` on a canary scaledobject. applying now.
deploy-bot: patch applied by mike_sre at 2026-02-18T09:41:12Z -> scaledobject/model-pool-scaledobj
ben_infra: after minReplicas bump and cooldown reduction, we see spin-up time reduced: pod ready in ~18s instead of 45s end-to-end. gateway 504s dropped for acme traffic in the next window.
support_anne: I'll update ACME: short-term mitigation applied (minReplicas=1 + cooldown tuned). offer 50% credit for the 09:20-09:45 window? ops-billing, thoughts?
maya_oncall: ops-billing pls advise.
ben_infra: root cause summary draft: scaledobject cooldown+polling interval too long combined with HPA minReplicas=0 -> warm-up delay during concurrent tenant bursts. metric polling 30s + cooldown 120s created long window where KEDA didn't react quickly to sudden spike. Also observed intermittent metric API 503s causing scaler churn.
raj_keda: repro steps in dev to simulate:
```bash
# load test that reproduces queueing
kubectl -n test apply -f loadgen.yaml  # uses 500 concurrent short requests
# watch scaledobject and pods
kubectl -n test get scaledobject model-pool-scaledobj -w
kubectl -n test get pods -l app=model-pool -w
# observe that with minReplicas=0 and cooldown=120s you get >10s extra queue time
```

mike_sre: follow-up actions:
- revert map: add default minReplicas=1 for tenant pools with heavy onboarding traffic (ops ticket created: #OPS-4321)
- add prewarm annotation to our onboarding scaledobjects (ENG-PR: add keda prewarm flag)
- harden metric API retries (research on why 503s during burst)
- add SLO alert: queue_length > 10 for >2m triggers auto-escalation

support_anne: customer comms sent: "we applied a configuration change to reduce scale-up latency and are monitoring, will follow up with RCA and credit proposal."
maya_oncall: monitoring dashboards show 504 count down to 0 in next 5m. will keep watching for 1h.
raj_keda: one more note — some scaledobjects had inconsistent annotations because our onboarding job mutated them without the prewarm tag. I'll open PR to ensure CI validates scaledobject annotations.
ben_infra: filing internal postmortem and linking this thread. recommend setting default pollingInterval to 10s for high-throughput pools.
support_anne: thanks team. Filing customer follow-up with timeline + RCAs. :white_check_mark:
